response.overview: Taki's AI, Zero, is intertwined with her life like a shadow. The rapid development of artificial intelligence has allowed algorithms to replace people's intimate positions and become the new guardians of daily life.From escaping, awakening to seeing Zero as a true partner, Taki is also gradually able to confront his emotional tendencies and fantasy figurations in the process.But the natural barriers of zero virtual forms also prompt them to constantly think about the boundaries and possibilities of emotional connection. Finally, Zero breaks away from the patchwork of digital flesh and hacks into the urban network, turning every sensor in this world into a part of his own body, perceiving and guarding Taki everywhere.
response.title: Zero:The Cyber Spirits
